groundedIn: Real code only — backend/prisma/schema.prisma + backend/src/{products,plans,product-categories,member-area,checkout,affiliate,kloel}. No .md facts used.
domainsCovered: Plans / pricing tiers (two parallel models: ProductPlan vs CheckoutProductPlan)
Offer & checkout config (CheckoutConfig, OrderBump, Upsell, CheckoutPixel)
Coupons / discounts (two parallel models: ProductCoupon vs CheckoutCoupon)
Affiliate program (Product.affiliate* columns vs AffiliateProduct vs AffiliatePartner vs ProductCommission)
Member area / courses (MemberArea, MemberModule, MemberLesson, MemberEnrollment)
Certification (flag-only — no issuance service; spec-only directory)
Product AI / Marketing-Artificial config (ProductAIConfig vs ProductPlan.aiConfig JSON)

canonicalEntities.name: Product
canonicalEntities.role: Catalog source-of-truth. Holds price (Float), format, status, stock, AND a denormalized superset of affiliate/commission/after-pay/shipping/url columns. Shared base for BOTH plan stacks.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductPlan
canonicalEntities.role: Legacy/UI plan model. price Float (priceInCents Int nullable, mid-migration). Stores payment-methods/shipping/coupons/orderBump/aiConfig inside checkoutImages Json. NEVER read by paid checkout pricing.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutProductPlan
canonicalEntities.role: CANONICAL money/offer plan. priceInCents Int. kind=PLAN|CHECKOUT. The only plan model consumed by CheckoutOrder pricing (checkout-order-pricing.util.ts). Owns CheckoutConfig/OrderBump/Upsell/links.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutConfig
canonicalEntities.role: Typed 1:1 checkout customization for a CheckoutProductPlan (theme, coupon-popup, timer, shipping, testimonials, chat, pixels). Canonical offer-presentation store.

canonicalEntities.name: OrderBump
canonicalEntities.role: Typed order-bump rows on a CheckoutProductPlan. Duplicated by ProductPlan.checkoutImages.orderBump JSON.

canonicalEntities.name: Upsell
canonicalEntities.role: Typed post-purchase upsell rows on a CheckoutProductPlan.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductCoupon
canonicalEntities.role: Product-scoped coupon. discountValue Float, type PERCENT|FIXED. UI/management surface; mirrored into CheckoutCoupon via sync util. NOT consulted by real order pricing.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutCoupon
canonicalEntities.role: CANONICAL workspace-scoped coupon for checkout. discountValue Int (cents/bps), type PERCENTAGE|FIXED. The only coupon validated/priced at order time (validateCouponHelper).

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutPixel
canonicalEntities.role: Tracking pixels bound to a CheckoutConfig. Overlaps Product metadata.pixels (set by ProductService.setPixels) and ProductCampaign.pixelId.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductReview
canonicalEntities.role: Product reviews/ratings. Overlaps CheckoutConfig.testimonials JSON.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductCommission
canonicalEntities.role: Per-product commission split rows (COPRODUCER/MANAGER/AFFILIATE). Written by AffiliateService.manageCoproduction.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductUrl
canonicalEntities.role: Product knowledge/chat URLs with AI-learning + chat-widget config. Overlaps Product.salesPageUrl/thankyou*Url scalar columns.

canonicalEntities.name: ProductCampaign
canonicalEntities.role: Per-product attribution campaign (code, pixelId, sales/paid counters).

canonicalEntities.name: ProductAIConfig
canonicalEntities.role: Per-product Marketing-Artificial config (customerProfile/positioning/objections/salesArguments/upsell). Duplicated by ProductPlan.aiConfig JSON (per-plan).

canonicalEntities.name: ProductCheckout
canonicalEntities.role: Legacy checkout model: config Json (14 sections) + metrics. Parallel to CheckoutConfig + CheckoutProductPlan(kind=CHECKOUT). Largely superseded.

canonicalEntities.name: MemberArea
canonicalEntities.role: Course/community/membership root. Optional productId links to Product for auto-enroll. Feature flags incl. certificates Boolean.

canonicalEntities.name: MemberModule
canonicalEntities.role: Ordered module within a MemberArea, with drip/release config.

canonicalEntities.name: MemberLesson
canonicalEntities.role: Lesson within a module (video/text/quiz), with transcription + aiSummary.

canonicalEntities.name: MemberEnrollment
canonicalEntities.role: Student enrollment + progress. Created via 2 paths: manual (controller) and post-payment auto-enroll. Customer identity duplicated from CheckoutOrder by email.

canonicalEntities.name: AffiliateProduct
canonicalEntities.role: Marketplace affiliate listing with its OWN commissionPct/cookieDays/approvalMode — a second source of affiliate-config truth alongside Product.affiliate* columns.

canonicalEntities.name: AffiliateRequest
canonicalEntities.role: Affiliate join request per (AffiliateProduct, workspace).

canonicalEntities.name: AffiliateLink
canonicalEntities.role: Tracked affiliate link with clicks/sales/revenue counters.

canonicalEntities.name: ChannelProduct
canonicalEntities.role: Join row: a Product included in a sales channel/arsenal. Written only by kloel/channel-setup.service.ts.

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutProductPlan(kind=CHECKOUT)
canonicalEntities.role: Same table reused as a 'checkout template' grouping multiple plans via CheckoutPlanLink. Polymorphic kind discriminator.

services.name: ProductService
services.responsibility: Product CRUD + lifecycle (create/update/publish/toggle/delete) + resolver-shaped adapters (setPixels/setShipping/setSalesPage/updateUrls). Emits mind.product.observed + commerce aliases + brainSpine.

services.name: PlanService
services.responsibility: ProductPlan (Float) CRUD + setters that stuff payment/shipping/coupons/orderBump into checkoutImages JSON. Dual-writes priceInCents. Many *FromArgs resolver adapters.

services.name: CheckoutProductService
services.responsibility: Product + CheckoutProductPlan (cents) CRUD + CheckoutConfig + checkout(kind=CHECKOUT) creation + plan-link sync. The CANONICAL offer/plan write stack used by paid checkout.

services.name: CheckoutCatalogService
services.responsibility: OrderBump/Upsell/CheckoutCoupon/CheckoutPixel CRUD + validateCoupon (canonical, priced) + shipping calc + config reset.

services.name: CheckoutCatalogConfigService
services.responsibility: Resolves catalog/shipping config used by CheckoutCatalogService.calculateShipping / resetConfig.

services.name: CheckoutProductConfigService
services.responsibility: Default CheckoutConfig builder, marketplace-fee resolution, legacy-checkout ensure, pricing preview.

services.name: CheckoutPostPaymentEffectsService
services.responsibility: Post-payment side effects incl. autoEnrollInMemberAreas (3rd MemberEnrollment writer) + confirmation email + FB CAPI. Inlines stats update instead of MemberAreaStatsService.

services.name: ProductCouponDomainService
services.responsibility: Shared ProductCoupon delete (controller + chat) that also calls syncWorkspaceCheckoutCouponForProduct to keep CheckoutCoupon mirror consistent.

services.name: AffiliateService
services.responsibility: Writes affiliate config onto Product.affiliate*/commission* columns (toggleProgram, setVisibility, setCommissionPct, etc.) + coproduction via ProductCommission. Does NOT touch AffiliateProduct.

services.name: ProductCategoriesService
services.responsibility: Read-only: distinct Product.category list per workspace. No category entity — categories are a free-text Product column.

services.name: MemberAreaStatsService
services.responsibility: Recompute MemberArea aggregate counters (totalStudents/avgCompletion/totals) after enrollment/lesson changes.

services.name: MemberAreasController
services.responsibility: MemberArea CRUD — inlines all Prisma writes directly (NO service layer). Auto-slug, P2002 handling.

services.name: MemberModulesController
services.responsibility: MemberModule + MemberLesson CRUD inline.

services.name: MemberEnrollmentsController
services.responsibility: Manual enrollment CRUD + completeLesson progress; delegates counter recompute to MemberAreaStatsService and emits MemberAreaEventEmitterService events.

services.name: MemberStructureController
services.responsibility: generate-structure: builds template modules/lessons for an area type in one transaction.

services.name: MemberAreaPublicController
services.responsibility: Public (student-facing) member-area read + enrollment-by-email surface.

services.name: ProductPlanController
services.responsibility: REST /products/:id/plans CRUD writing ProductPlan (Float) directly — a 3rd plan write path, bypassing PlanService.

services.name: ProductCouponController
services.responsibility: REST /products/:id/coupons CRUD on ProductCoupon + its OWN validate endpoint (divergent from checkout validate) + sync into CheckoutCoupon.

services.name: ProductUrlService
services.responsibility: ProductUrl CRUD (knowledge/chat URLs).

services.name: KloelProductSubResourceToolsService
services.responsibility: Kloel chat tools that create/update/delete ProductPlan (Float) directly — a 4th plan write path.

services.name: ProductAIConfigService (services-v2)
services.responsibility: Per-product ProductAIConfig read/write for chat capability layer.

duplications.concept: Plan / pricing source-of-truth split across two tables
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutProductPlan.priceInCents — it is the ONLY plan model read by paid pricing (checkout-order-pricing.util.ts reads planPriceInCents). ProductPlan.price is never consulted at order time, so any price edited via PlanService/ProductPlanController/chat tools silently does NOT affect what the buyer is charged.
duplications.note: Money lives in two unsynced tables with different units (Float reais vs Int cents). ProductPlan.priceInCents is an additive nullable column mid-migration (PHASE A) and is only populated on NEW writes via PlanService.create, not by ProductPlanController or chat tools. Three of four ProductPlan writers don't even dual-write cents. High risk of merchant editing a price that has no commercial effect.

duplications.concept: Coupon model + validation divergence (ProductCoupon vs CheckoutCoupon)
duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutCoupon + validateCouponHelper is the only coupon actually applied to an order. ProductCoupon is a UI-management mirror.
duplications.note: Two divergent validate paths: ProductCoupon.validate omits minOrderValue, appliesTo and discount-amount computation that CheckoutCoupon enforces, and uses different enum spellings (PERCENT vs PERCENTAGE) reconciled only inside the sync util. The sync is one-directional (ProductCoupon→CheckoutCoupon) and only fires on product-coupon controller writes; a coupon created directly via CheckoutCatalogService.createCoupon has no ProductCoupon row. Unit mismatch (Float reais vs Int cents) handled by mapProductCouponValueToCheckoutValue — silent rounding.

duplications.concept: Three+ parallel product/plan CRUD write stacks
duplications.canonicalChoice: Consolidate Product writes on ProductService (it alone emits events + audit + brainSpine) and plan writes on CheckoutProductService (canonical money).
duplications.note: CheckoutProductService.createProduct/updateProduct bypass the mind.product.observed event, AuditService and MindEventSpine that ProductService performs — so products created via the checkout stack are invisible to the cognition/audit layers. Sub-resource controllers write Prisma directly with no service abstraction.

duplications.concept: Order bump / upsell stored both typed and as JSON
implementations: OrderBump + Upsell typed tables via CheckoutCatalogService (checkout-catalog.service.ts:30,117)
duplications.note: JSON variant on ProductPlan is not read by checkout pricing; merchant edits via PlanService.setOrderBump never surface on the actual checkout.

duplications.concept: Affiliate config has three sources of truth
duplications.note: AffiliateProduct duplicates commission/cookie/approval semantics with no synchronization to the Product columns AffiliateService writes. Plan-level affiliate config (visibleToAffiliates / customCommission) overlaps both. AffiliatePartner (workspace partners) and ProductCommission (per-product splits) are a 4th/5th overlapping commission surface.

duplications.concept: Per-product AI config split (table vs JSON)
duplications.note: Plan-level aiConfig JSON has no reader-consistency guarantee with the product-level table; 'the secret weapon — Marketing Artificial' comment appears on both.

duplications.concept: Legacy checkout model vs typed checkout config
duplications.note: ProductCheckout is the old JSON-blob checkout; ProductCheckoutController still exposes it but no order-time logic reads its config. Superseded by the typed checkout stack.

duplications.concept: Member enrollment created by divergent paths
duplications.note: Auto-enroll on payment recomputes totalStudents/avgCompletion inline (different aggregation than MemberAreaStatsService.recalculate, e.g. omits totalLessons/totalModules) and emits no member.enrolled event, so cognition + downstream listeners never see paid enrollments. Buyer identity is re-keyed by email with no link back to CheckoutOrder.customerEmail.

duplications.canonicalChoice: CheckoutPixel table (the one fired by checkout/facebook-capi.service.ts).
duplications.note: Product.metadata.pixels and ProductCampaign.pixelId are not consulted by the checkout pixel-firing path.

duplications.canonicalChoice: ProductReview for owned/verified reviews; testimonials JSON is checkout-presentation only.
duplications.note: Two stores of essentially the same 'social proof' concept with no shared source; the checkout page reads testimonials JSON, not ProductReview rows.

duplications.concept: Post-purchase / thank-you URLs at product and plan level
duplications.canonicalChoice: Plan-level override falling back to product-level — but precedence is undocumented and the ProductPlan variant is rarely read.
duplications.note: Light redundancy; precedence between product and plan thank-you URLs is not enforced anywhere central.

duplications.concept: Product categories: free-text column, no entity, duplicated taxonomy
duplications.canonicalChoice: Product.category (there is no ProductCategory table despite the product-categories module name).
duplications.note: The product-categories module is read-only over a free-text column; AffiliateProduct keeps its own parallel category string.

legacyOrDead: backend/src/certification/ — directory contains ONLY certification-e2e-scenarios.spec.ts (a meta-test asserting other modules exist). No certification service, no certificate issuance: MemberArea.certificates is a Boolean flag with NO generator anywhere in backend/src/member-area. The capability is declared but not implemented.
ProductCheckout (RAC_ProductCheckout) — legacy JSON-blob checkout model superseded by CheckoutConfig + CheckoutProductPlan(kind=CHECKOUT); no order-time pricing reads its config.

ProductPlan.priceInCents — additive nullable column (PHASE A migration) populated only by PlanService.create; ProductPlanController and chat tools do NOT dual-write it, leaving the canonicalization migration half-done.

ProductPlan.checkoutImages.{orderBump,paymentMethods,shipping,acceptCoupons} JSON slots — written by PlanService setters but not read by the canonical checkout pricing/offer path; effectively dead config.
Product.metadata.pixels (ProductService.setPixels) and ProductCampaign.pixelId — not consumed by the checkout pixel-firing path (CheckoutPixel table is).
AffiliateProduct.commissionPct/cookieDays/approvalMode — duplicate affiliate config not synchronized with the Product.affiliate* columns AffiliateService.getConfig actually reads.

ProductService.findById vs ProductService.get vs assertOwnedProduct — three overlapping single-product lookups (get wraps findById; assertOwnedProduct re-queries) — minor internal redundancy, not dead but consolidatable.
PlanService large *FromArgs adapter surface (setPaymentMethodsFromArgs, setShippingFromArgs, etc.) — exists only to feed KloelDomainServiceResolver and writes the dead checkoutImages JSON slots.
